newsitem.title: USA: Heartland files for 1.5 mln share offer.
newsitem.headline: Heartland files for 1.5 mln share offer.

text.p: Heartland Express Inc said on Thursday that its president, Russell Gerdin, plans to sell as much as 1.5 million common shares in a public offering.

The Iowa City, Iowa,-based truckload carrier said in a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission that the sale will reduce Gerdin's stake to 43 percent, or 13,019,990 shares, from 48.4 percent, or 14,519,990 currently.
The offering will be made through Alex Brown & Sons and Morga Keegan& Co Inc. The underwriters have an over-allotment option of up to 225,000 shares, according to the filing.
The company said buyers under the offering will not be entitled to shares payable under a 50 percent, pro-rata stock dividend to stockholders of record on September 23 and payable on October 4.
The stock dividend will increase the company's outstanding common shares to 30 million, from 20 million, it said.
